{{Short description|Polish bryologist (born 1949)}}
{{other people|Ochyra|Ochyra (surname)}}
'''Ryszard Ochyra''' (born 1949) is a Polish [[bryology|bryologist]]. He has focused on moss systematics of the [[Southern Hemisphere]], specifically in the families [[Amblystegiaceae]], [[Dicranaceae]], [[Grimmiaceae]], and [[Seligeriaceae]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Prof. Dr. Hab. Ryszard Ochyra |url=https://botany.pl/index.php/pl/institute-pl/people-pl/research-staff-pl/574-ryszard-ochyra-pl |website=botany.pl |publisher=[[Władysław Szafer Institute of Botany of the Polish Academy of Sciences]] |access-date=27 August 2024 |language=pl-pl}}</ref> Throughout his career, he has described 48 species of moss considered new to science.

==Biography==
Ochyra was born on 10 September 1949 in [[Rozbórz]], Poland.
He studied biology at [[Jagiellonian University]], and remained at the university for his post-graduate work. He obtained his master's degree in botany in 1972  while studying under {{ill|Jan Kornaś|pl}}, and earned his doctorate in 1976.<ref name=tribute>{{cite journal |last1=Plášek |first1=Vítězslav |title=Halina Bednarek-Ochyra and Ryszard Ochyra: A tribute to their contribution to bryology |journal=Acta Musei Silesiae, Scientiae Naturales |date=1 July 2019 |volume=68 |issue=1-2 |pages=1–9 |doi=10.2478/cszma-2019-0001 |url=https://sciendo.com/article/10.2478/cszma-2019-0001 |access-date=27 August 2024 |language=en|doi-access=free }}</ref>

He took part in the Fourth Antarctic Expedition of the Polish Academy of Sciences, where he studied bryology on [[King George Island (South Shetland Islands)|King George Island]] from 1979 to 1980.<ref name=tribute/> He was based on [[Henryk Arctowski Polish Antarctic Station]].<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Myrcha |first1=Andrzej |title=IV Antarctic Expedition to the Arctowski Station (King George Island, November 1979 —May 1980) |journal=Polish Polar Research |date=1980 |volume=1 |issue=4 |pages=191–204 |url=https://journals.pan.pl/Content/111644/PDF/1980_4_191-204.pdf |access-date=27 August 2024}}</ref>

In 1986, Ochyra married [[Halina Bednarek-Ochyra]], a noted bryologist and botanist. Together they have undertook several bryological expeditions and made large contributions to the herbarium of the [[Polish Academy of Sciences]].<ref name=tribute/>

==Legacy==
In 1986, botanist and mycologist {{ill|Jiří Váňa|cs}} [[circumscription (taxonomy)|circumscribed]] the moss genus ''[[Ochyraea]]'', which is in the family Amblystegiaceae and named in Rysard's honor.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Results|url=http://www.theplantlist.org/tpl1.1/search?q=Ochyraea|access-date=26 January 2022|website=[[The Plant List]]}}</ref>

==Works==
Between 1974 and 2019, Ochyra published 1,580 works. He has described or coauthored 48 new species of moss.<ref name=tribute/> Between 1978 and 2000, Ochyra co-edited and distributed five bryophyte [[exsiccata]] series, among others ''Musci Poloniae exsiccati, ab Instituto Botanico Academiae Scientiarum Polonae editi'', ''Bryophyta Antarctica exsiccata'' and together with [[Tamás Pócs]] ''Bryophyta Africana selecta''.<ref name="Triebel & Scholz 2001-2026">Triebel, D. & Scholz, P. 2001–2026 ''IndExs – Index of Exsiccatae''. – Botanische Staatssammlung München: http://indexs.botanischestaatssammlung.de. – München, Germany.</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Musci Poloniae exsiccati, ab Instituto Botanico Academiae Scientiarum Polonae editi: IndExs ExsiccataID=1221021567 |website=IndExs – Index of Exsiccatae |publisher=Botanische Staatssammlung München |url=https://www.botanischestaatssammlung.de/DatabaseClients/IndExs/Exsiccatae_IndExs_Details.jsp?ExsiccataID=1221021567 |access-date=18 April 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Bryophyta Antarctica exsiccata: IndExs ExsiccataID=738186368 |website=IndExs – Index of Exsiccatae |publisher=Botanische Staatssammlung München |url=https://www.botanischestaatssammlung.de/DatabaseClients/IndExs/Exsiccatae_IndExs_Details.jsp?ExsiccataID=738186368 |access-date=5 April 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Bryophyta Africana selecta: IndExs ExsiccataID=238500736 |website=IndExs – Index of Exsiccatae |publisher=Botanische Staatssammlung München |url=https://www.botanischestaatssammlung.de/DatabaseClients/IndExs/Exsiccatae_IndExs_Details.jsp?ExsiccataID=238500736 |access-date=18 April 2026}}</ref>
